biggest_catch: You only get paid after your friend opens an LMCU checking account through YOUR referral link and keeps two or more recurring direct deposits totaling $500+ for a full 60 days. If your friend joins but never sets up that direct deposit, you earn nothing.
catches: Friend must open a qualified LMCU membership with checking account using the Advocate's referral link and meet program criteria: hold two or more recurring direct deposit(s) totaling $500.00 or more for 60 days.
Both Advocate and Friend must be over 18; Advocate must be a primary LMCU member in good standing with a valid email on file.
Referrer cap: up to $550 per year (five $110 referrals).
Following qualification, LMCU deposits $110 into the Advocate's primary savings account within 14 business days.
No 1099/tax statement is mentioned on the fetched page; standard referral bonuses may be reportable.

steps: Enter the email you use with your LMCU account to get your unique referral link.
Share your referral link with friends or family by email, text, or social media.
Your friend opens a qualified LMCU membership with checking account using your link.
Your friend holds two or more recurring direct deposits totaling $500+ for 60 days.
LMCU deposits $110 into your primary savings account (and $110 into your friend's) within 14 business days of qualification.
timing: $110 deposited to the Advocate's primary savings within 14 business days after the friend qualifies (which requires 60 days of $500+ direct deposits).
when_cash_arrives: $110 deposited to the Advocate's primary savings within 14 business days after the friend qualifies (which requires 60 days of $500+ direct deposits). Terms impose a fixed waiting period after the friend's account opens - nothing arrives before that date.
maximize: Refer early and have your friend complete ALL qualifying activity in the first days of the window - late qualification pushes the fixed payout date even further out.
Both accounts must stay open and in good standing through the entire wait - early closure forfeits the bonus.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the program's terms lock payout to a fixed date (60-120 days out) regardless of how fast your friend qualifies.
